goal: replace the M265 analytical rank3 stage boundary with one integrated executable RTL context

matched_boundary.config_frame: six ordered 256-bit beats carrying 1349 payload bits and zero padding
matched_boundary.raw_tile_frame: five ordered 256-bit beats carrying 160 signed INT8 values
matched_boundary.result: five ordered registered-FIFO beats per tile, each 48 bits with 32 valid event bits

integrated_candidate.stage1: five cycles, 96 signed INT8 products per cycle, 48 signed24 accumulators, frozen RNE/saturating Q24-to-Q8 requant
integrated_candidate.stage2: five cycles, 96 M37-class CSD shift/negate/add products per cycle, two temporal rows by sixteen lanes

required: one-tile and multi-tile exact cycle equality
integer reference equality for every emitted tag, beat, valid mask and event bit
exact six-beat config and five-beat raw framing
96 stage1 products and 96 stage2 CSD products per active cycle
registered result FIFO backpressure including full simultaneous pop/push
context release blocked until every raw/intermediate/product/FIFO state drains
early/late last, tag drift, nonzero config padding and noncanonical CSD fail closed

fixed_baseline.source: M31 exact96 dense path and M265 legal 17-cycle tile-closed witness

prohibited_claims: DC, STA, power, energy or PPA
